name: Original Vampire
summary: The top of the food chain. The sun can hurt an Original but never kill one; only a White Oak Stake can.
daylight: Sunlight burns but cannot kill. Originals are immortal to the sun.
strengths: The best stats in the game
Commands a sire line: vampires it turns share its bloodline
Faster and stronger than a normal vampire
weaknesses: The [[white-oak-stake]], the only thing that can kill it

sections.heading: Staying alive
sections.body:
- [[inhuman-potion]]: immunity to the [[white-oak-ash-dagger]] for 5 hours
- [[sanguis-tuus-vita-mea]]: a witch links her life to yours
- Sun damage: [[sun-ring-pass]], [[temporary-sun-ring]] or [[vampire-hat]]
